title: PhysicsTest run matrix (physicstest.matrix/1)
description: Config/Matrices/<name>.json, read by Tools/ptbench (python -I -m ptbench run --matrix <name>; 03_WorkPlan M8, 02_Architecture 12.5). Cells = targets x profiles x scenes x threads minus the exclude rules; every repeat runs each cell once in a block shuffled with a seed derived from block_seed (docs/ResultsSchema.md 11).

purpose.description: perf: timing tables (R >= 5 is the protocol, 02 12.5; the report marks fewer). determinism: DET1 groups (fresh processes of one exe, same T), usually with -HashEvery=1 for the first divergent frame. M9 (behavior) and M11 (thread series) extend this enum and the schema version.

preset.description: The build whose out/<preset>/bin/PhysicsTestBench.exe runs the matrix (headline timing: test or test-avx2). --exe / --preset override it.

cooldown_s.description: Wait before every run (02 12.5: 2 s); the system load during it is recorded.

timeout_s.description: A run that does not end in time is killed and recorded as timed_out (no exit.json).

contaminated_retries.description: Fresh-process retries of a run that ends with exit code 4 (default 2); the cell is 'contaminated' when every attempt ends with 4.

window.description: The scene window whose per-run mean is the run's value (default headline).

bench_args.description: Extra PhysicsTestBench switches for every run (e.g. -HashEvery=1 for a determinism matrix). ptbench refuses a switch key (case-insensitive, before '='; -ini: up to [Section]:Key) that appears twice for a cell over the matrix's, the target's and --bench-arg switches - the bench reads the first occurrence only (FParse::Value) - and the switches the runner sets per cell (-Out, -Backend, -BackendProfile, -Profile, -Scenario, -Param:, -Threads, -Frames, -Repeat, -Order, -BlockSeed, -Session) or that start another mode (-Gate, -List, -Describe, -Conformance, -AnalyticReferences, -SceneHashes, -BusyHelper).

label.description: The series label of a table (engine.variant).

bench_args.description: Extra PhysicsTestBench switches for this target only (e.g. an -ini: or -ExecCmds variant of one engine; M8 review: forward-compatible for M9 / M11). No key may repeat one of the matrix's bench_args or --bench-arg (the bench would read only the first occurrence, so the position never decides), nor be a runner switch (see bench_args). The label must tell the target apart: tables group by label.

exclude.description: Cells to leave out: every named field must match (a list means any of; params: every named parameter). E.g. {"backend": "Bullet", "T": [2, 3, 4, 5, 6], "reason": "Bullet runs T = 1 only (02 9.6)"}.
